## Trigger Conditions
This error is returned by the contract when:
- `IntentNotCancellable` validation fails during entrypoint invocation.


---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Cancel the scheduled intent before its execute_after timestamp; once the execution window opens, cancellation is no longer allowed.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let now = f.env.ledger().timestamp();
let id = schedule_intent(&f, now, now + DAY);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_cancel_scheduled(&f.sender, &id));
```

This reproduction is derived from the contract's error surface tests in `error_surface_test.rs`.
